verdict.rationale: Anthropic documents the Agent SDK as giving developers 'full control over orchestration, tool access, and permissions,' and Claude Code supports integrations like Jira/Slack/custom tooling that leads could presumably scope. However, community reports describe undisclosed, silently-injected 'fake_tools' definitions and other opaque behaviors baked into every API request, undermining the claim that an engineering lead has full visibility or control over which tools the agent can access.
